title: Flue agent local synthesis — architecture diagnosis
description: Five root causes, strengths to preserve, exact missing invariants, file map, and prioritized local fix slices with file:line evidence.

rootCauses.consequence: Task shows completed while user may have received nothing

rootCauses.what_happens: final files exist only in sandbox; ledger stores metadata only
rootCauses.consequence: No durable artifacts to resend after sandbox.destroy

rootCauses.root_cause: Agent narration treated as success (no validator)
rootCauses.what_happens: agent may narrate success without calling terminal tool
rootCauses.consequence: observer may destroy sandbox; no deliverable exists

rootCauses.root_cause: Setup stages in single retry scope
rootCauses.what_happens: All setup steps run inside one queue attempt; failures replay from start, retries exhausted => generic terminal failure
rootCauses.consequence: Repeated transient errors become terminal with redacted diagnostics

rootCauses.what_happens: Natural follow-ups are rejected unless '/task' or specific query
rootCauses.consequence: Recovery attempts start new tasks; prior results not re-sent

strengths.strength: Queue state machine prevents unsafe replay
Existing unit tests for ledger & observability
strengths.notes: durable-object tests & projectTaskActivity projections. src/durable-objects/task-ledger.test.ts; src/observability/task-activity.test.ts

Five root causes with concrete consequences and evidence (file:line)

rows.title: Invariant: validated deliverable before completion
rows.body: Do not mark completed unless a structured deliverable exists (summary or file or PR URL persisted).

rows.title: Invariant: results outlive sandboxes
rows.body: Artifacts or references must be stored durably before sandbox.destroy is called.

rows.title: Invariant: stage-scoped durable checkpoints
rows.body: Each setup stage must have a durable checkpoint and classified transient/permanent error handling.

rows.title: Invariant: delivery ack recorded
rows.body: Outbound delivery must produce a persisted acknowledgement (or enter delivery_failed) before task is final.

rows.title: Invariant: natural-repair routing
rows.body: Natural-language recovery should route to the latest task context rather than create a new task.

props.content:
**P0 — block empty completion & add tests.** P0 — Add deliverable validator; unit tests for processTaskMessage pre/post-dispatch; completeGeneralTask/publish tests. Evidence: src/tools/task-tools.ts:323-344; src/tasks/processor.ts:259-405.

**P1 — split stages & add reconciliation.** P1 — Introduce per-stage checkpoints (setup_github, setup_workspace, dispatching, delivering) and add bounded retries and a dispatch reconciliation job using dispatchId. Evidence: src/durable-objects/task-ledger.ts:1258-1294; src/tasks/processor.ts:369-389.

**P1 — durable deliverable & outbox.** P1 — Persist final artifacts (R2/KV or ledger blob) before sandbox.destroy; record delivery_ack state and implement /resend command. Evidence: src/tools/task-tools.ts:398-424; src/telegram/files.ts:23-46.

**P2 — policy & tool profile changes.** P2 — Restrict repo tooling to confirmed repo tasks; classify errors; expose structured diagnostic tokens for ops (error_class, failed_stage). Evidence: src/durable-objects/task-ledger.ts:336-386; src/tasks/processor.ts:32-39.
